name: MineDojo
summary: 基于 Minecraft 的交互式仿真套件，提供探索、采集、制作等任务及逐步动作与观测。此条目收录生成环境；附带网络视频与知识库不作为已对齐动作轨迹的规模。
scale: Simulation suite with thousands of configurable tasks; knowledge-base media totals are separate
organizations: NVIDIA, Caltech, Stanford and UT Austin contributors
license: MIT for code; source media and Minecraft assets have separate terms
wmNote: 适合交互式游戏世界模型和长时程 agent。数据来源复杂，代码许可不等于所有视频、文本与游戏资产均采用 MIT 许可。
summaryEn: An interactive Minecraft simulation suite with exploration, gathering and crafting tasks plus stepwise actions and observations. This entry covers the environment; accompanying web videos and knowledge databases are not counted as aligned action trajectories.
wmNoteEn: Useful for interactive game world models and long-horizon agents. Code licensing does not automatically cover all source videos, text, or game assets.
scaleZh: 包含数千项可配置任务的仿真套件；知识库媒体总量另计
organizationsZh: NVIDIA、加州理工学院、斯坦福大学与得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校贡献者
accessZh: 开放获取，具体取决于数据来源
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT 许可；源媒体与 Minecraft 资产另有条款

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - MineDojo/MineDojo: Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents with Internet-Scale Knowledge · GitHub
evidence.statement: Official environment exposes multimodal observations and compound actions for step-based Minecraft interaction. Scope is the simulator, not its static wiki assets.
